summary: First-finish smoke test of Horse Yard Manager. Backend: 14/14 critical endpoints working after using correct schemas (Vaccination capitalized, expenses need category, checkout needs horse_count, reset-password uses 'password' field). Frontend: landing, login (admin creds), dashboard stats, horses page, add-horse modal all functional. RBAC enforced (owner blocked from creating/deleting horses with 403). Stripe checkout returns valid checkout_url + session_id with amount=$4 for 1 horse.
passed: POST /api/auth/reset-password invalid token -> 400 'Invalid or expired token'
POST /api/payments/checkout -> 200 with Stripe checkout_url and session_id (amount=$4)
Frontend landing page renders (Sign in, Get started, yard size calculator)
Login flow (admin) redirects to /dashboard with welcome toast
Dashboard shows Horses on yard=1, Yard fee=$4.00, Overdue Vaccination card
Horses page + Add horse modal open with all form fields (name, breed, color, stable wing, passport, UELN, owner, lease status, monthly livery)

failed.issue: Care event category expects capitalized 'Vaccination|Farrier|Dental|Physio' (not lowercase); expenses require 'category' field; checkout requires 'horse_count' in body; reset-password body uses 'password' not 'new_password'. Not a bug, but review request payload examples in the problem statement don't match backend schemas.
failed.evidence: 422 validation errors on lowercase category, missing category, missing horse_count, missing password

failed.issue: POST /api/horses ignores unknown fields 'age' and 'livery_type' silently; expected field is 'monthly_livery' (not 'monthly_livery_fee'). Non-blocking but frontend must use correct field names.

action_items: No blockers. Optionally document exact request schemas (capitalized care categories, expense category required, checkout horse_count required, horse field 'monthly_livery') for future consumers.
